post_install_message:
## DegenFeed Self-Hosted is LIVE! 🚀

| URL | Description |
|-----|------------|
| https://$DOMAIN/ | DegenFeed profile + content hub |
| https://$DOMAIN/articles | Blog (Ghost) |
| https://$DOMAIN/articles/ghost | Blog Admin |
| https://$DOMAIN/coin | Creator Coin |
| https://$DOMAIN/live | Live Streams |
| @$CREATOR_USERNAME@$DOMAIN | ActivityPub handle |

### Next Steps

1. **Set up your blog:** Visit https://$DOMAIN/articles/ghost to create admin account
2. **Connect accounts:** Go to Settings → Connected Accounts
3. **Creator coin:** Configure at https://$DOMAIN/admin/coin
4. **Backups:** Set up automated backups (see docs)

### Useful Commands

```bash
# View logs
docker compose logs -f

# Update
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d

# Backup
tar czf backup.tar.gz data/ .env articles/
```

📖 Full guide: https://docs.degenfeed.xyz/self-host
💬 Support: https://discord.gg/degenfeed
